selection: Five-family milestone closeout: four accepted checkpoints, fifth implemented with final combined validation incomplete.

features.name: rich_annotations
features.scope: Scalar/enum/class/array/nested annotation values and defaults, supported source declarations, retention, placement, classfile metadata and consumers.
restrictions: Byte/Short/unsigned annotation elements, non-star KClass bounds, repeatable/container emission and annotation construction expressions remain bounded or unsupported.
Larger kt10136 upstream original still fails at ordinary assertion/lambda resolution; defaultParameterValues retains an unsupported interpolation boundary. Neither is claimed to pass.
Unchanged NIA NiaDispatchers passes with real javax.inject; no new AndroidBible full-file or full-app claim.

features.name: class_header_delegation
features.scope: Saved interface delegate receivers, abstract forwarding/properties, explicit overrides, bounded generic substitutions and bridges.
restrictions: Public ordinary top-level delegators and abstract interface contracts; supported invariant Kotlin generics and nongeneric Java scalar/reference signatures.
Default interface bodies, decorated or generic methods, nested/internal contracts, delegating objects/data/enums and complex erased overlaps are explicit boundaries.
Actual AndroidBible inventory contains no class-header delegation uses, so no new app-file pass is claimed.

features.name: expanded_objects
features.scope: Data object equality/hash/string contracts, nested interface implementations, singleton initialization and metadata; object class inheritance and named companions remain outside this checkpoint.
restrictions: Object class inheritance and source named companions are not included.
The larger original multipleInstances still fails at reflection Constructor/apply receiver resolution; duplicate-instance semantics pass independent fixed Java reflection and serialization checks.
Unchanged AndroidBible AudioBar now advances past data objects but remains blocked at a local delegated property.

features.name: member_extensions
features.scope: Separate dispatch and extension receivers for member/companion functions and extension properties.
restrictions: Family suite passed62positive/9invalid/11unsupported on v1. Integrated generic getter regression was repaired and focused checks pass; final combined v2 acceptance interrupted at user request.
Source named companions, interface extensions, method-generic setters and generic/inferred/annotated source extension properties remain bounded.

features.name: source_inline_reified
features.scope: Real source inline expansion, bounded reification and inline parameter/return rules.
restrictions: Top-level static bodies only; member/receiver inline functions, default/vararg inline parameters, body exception tables and generated inline closures remain explicitly unsupported.
Bounded reified tests/casts/class literals; nested generic reification, generic classifier operations, array creation and PublishedApi semantics remain explicit boundaries.
Scalar Short is a prerequisite within this family, not an extra feature count; ShortArray remains unsupported. No new unchanged AndroidBible whole-file pass is claimed.

limitations: Supported labels refer to the explicitly bounded preceding acceptance checkpoints; the latest combined full-suite validation was interrupted and is not certified complete.
Repairs and prerequisite scalar Short support are not separate feature counts. No full-app compatibility or performance claim.
